## MCP - Image Embedder

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/image-embedder

**Description:** Analyse une image via GPT-4o-mini et genere un embedding semantique

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["user_id", "guild_id", "user_request"],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur (credits, quotas)" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requete utilisateur originale" },
    "image_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL de l'image a analyser" },
    "image_base64": { "type": "string", "description": "Image encodee en base64" }
  }
}
```

**Note:** image_url OU image_base64 requis (au moins un des deux). API keys fournies par le systeme.

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": true,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["embedding", "analysis", "dimensions"],
  "domain": "vision"
}
```
